summary: Frontend regression after Phase 21 session-gating on /api/montecarlo — all Monte Carlo flows work end-to-end. Session token is a valid crypto-strong UUIDv4. Plain MC, correlated-draws MC, and stagflation-preset MC all completed with results rendered; ZERO 4xx/5xx responses observed on /api/montecarlo endpoints (confirms the axios X-Session-Token interceptor is injecting correctly). Scenarios save+list also verified (POST/GET /api/scenarios returned 200 with the crypto-strong UUID). Multi-Year Projection tab loads charts without errors.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic, chart still renders once card mounts. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: api.js uuidv4 fallback is correct (v4 bit-flag + variant bits). getSessionToken persists to localStorage — good.

Recharts width(-1) warning suggests a ResponsiveContainer mounts inside a hidden/empty parent momentarily during MC result render. Non-blocking but could be silenced by rendering charts only after data is present or setting minHeight on the wrapper.
test_credentials: None required — anonymous session token auto-minted in localStorage.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_iter23 scenario during the Scenarios test. Backend uses session-scoped storage so it will not leak across other sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session-gating on /api/montecarlo is now live. The frontend axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js injects X-Session-Token on every request. Verified: plain MC, mc-corr-toggle correlated run, mc-stagflation-preset run, Scenarios CRUD, Projection tab. Only cosmetic Recharts sizing warning remains.
